args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this constant is used to build the password reset link (as well as the rollup and scheduled export links). If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, users receive reset emails pointing at localhost, which matches the report.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production deployment configuration, and/or make BASE_URL fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error at startup) when PUBLIC_URL is missing in a non-development environment, instead of silently falling back to localhost. This prevents the same issue from recurring for other environment-dependent links in this file.
